segments.title: Call Kass Cold Open & Fake Commercials
segments.notes: Pre-recorded intro reel featuring surreal fake ads for 'Call CAS' with 844-721-CAS number, digitized from 80s/90s source tapes.

segments.title: Engagement Announcement & Proposal Story
segments.notes: Case Blackwell announces engagement to Ashley, recounts surprise proposal during staged family lunch, details ring designer conspiracy to delay rings, and discusses wedding planning philosophy (open bar, cost concerns).

segments.title: Call-In Segment: Wedding Advice, Trump, Diddy, Laura Loomer
segments.notes: Series of callers: Gina Darling (ex-stalker parody), Haas (10-year marriage advice), Entity (gifted slabbed Amazing Spider-Man wedding cover), Bonsai Bullfrog (breaks Diddy arrest news), Smoke Packs (sober wedding perspective), Card King (Aladdin fetish roast), Sub Orbital (Thailand-based engagement + Trump assassination analysis), Matt LaDell (cream team happiness officer, Guantanamo conflict resolution joke).

segments.title: Show Wrap-Up & Patreon Plug
segments.notes: Case thanks subscribers, plugs Thursday Patreon stream (Batman: Caped Crusader + Vince McMahon doc), shouts out Dank Sauce for call screens, raids Gina Darling.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell uses the 'Call Kass' call-in show to announce his engagement to Ashley, recounting the surprise proposal executed during a staged family lunch. The broadcast fields calls from community regulars covering wedding advice, the second Trump assassination attempt, Diddy's arrest, and Laura Loomer's transformation, before wrapping with Patreon plugs and a raid on Gina Darling.
